package main

import (
	"context"
	"time"

	"github.com/benjaco/devflow/pkg/database"
	"github.com/benjaco/devflow/pkg/project"
)

func init() {
	project.Register(project.Define(func(_ context.Context, b *project.Builder) error {
		b.Name("payload-tui-e2e").DefaultTarget("up")
		b.RequiredCLIs("node", "npm").RequiredEnv("DATABASE_URL")
		b.Env("NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED", "1").Env("NODE_OPTIONS", "--no-deprecation")
		install := b.Task("install").Command("npm", "ci", "--no-audit", "--no-fund").
			Inputs("package.json", "package-lock.json").Outputs("node_modules").Stamp()
		payload := database.PayloadCMS("payload").Config("payload.config.mjs").SchemaInputs("collections").
			MigrationDir("migrations").Command("node", "node_modules/payload/bin.js")
		payload.NewMigration(b).DependsOn(install)
		app := b.Service("app").DependsOn(install).
			Command("node", "node_modules/next/dist/bin/next", "dev", "--hostname", "127.0.0.1").
			Env("PORT", b.Port("app")).ReadyHTTP("app", "/health", 200).
			ReadyTimeout(60 * time.Second).RestartOnInputChange()
		payload.ConfigureDevService(app)
		b.Target("up", app)
		return nil
	}))
}
